```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
noble <- read_csv("dane/nobel_laureates.csv")

noble
```

```{r}
skimr::skim(noble)
```

```{r}
glimpse(noble)
```

```{r}
noble %>% 
  ggplot(aes(category, prize_amount_adjusted_sek, fill = category)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1/1000000, suffix = "mln")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25)
  )
```

```{r}
noble %>% 
  drop_na(birth_date) %>% 
  mutate(birth_day = wday(birth_date, 
                          week_start = 1, 
                          abbr = FALSE, 
                          label = TRUE),
         birth_day = fct_rev(birth_day)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = birth_day, fill = gender)) +
  geom_bar(colour = "grey30") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("female" = "white", "male" = "grey30")) +
  facet_wrap(~category) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )
```

```{r}
noble %>% 
  drop_na(known_name) %>% 
  count(gender)
```

```{r}
noble %>% 
  filter(!is.na(known_name), is.na(gender))
```

```{r}
noble %>% 
  drop_na(age_at_award) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(age_at_award, fill = gender)) +
  geom_histogram(colour = "black", breaks = seq(15, 100, by = 5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("female" = "white", "male" = "grey30")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 100, by = 5)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
noble %>% 
  drop_na(age_at_award) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(age_at_award, fill = gender)) +
  geom_histogram(colour = "black", breaks = seq(15, 100, by = 5)) +
  facet_wrap(~category) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("female" = "white", "male" = "grey30")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 100, by = 10)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
(interval(start = ymd("2005-11-16"), end = today()) / years()) %>% floor()

interval(start = ymd("2005-11-16"), end = today()) %>% {./years()} %>% floor()

interval(start = ymd("2005-11-16"), end = today()) %>% "/"(years()) %>% floor()
```

```{r}
noble %>%
  drop_na(known_name)
  mutate(kiedy_nobel = (interval(start = birth_date, end = date_awarded) / years()) %>% floor()) %>% 
  filter(kiedy_nobel != age_at_award)
```

```{r}
noble %>% 
  drop_na(known_name) %>% 
  count(known_name, sort = TRUE) %>% 
  filter(n > 1)
```
